VOMITOXIN:

Effective 9/12/26:
Maximum Moisture 25% (Subject to rejection)
Our drying rates are 5.0 cents/point broken on the half point (2.5 cents per half point) up to 20%, then 20.1% to 25% moisture is 6 cents/point broken on the half point (3.0 cents per half point).
Effective 9/21/26
VOMITOXIN:
5.0 ppm or less - No Discount
Over 5.0 Subject to rejection.
Clymers reserves the right to reject corn with vomitoxin levels over 5.0 ppm. We continue to monitor vomitoxin levels in our daily receipts to maintain co-product quality. See current corn discount schedules.
Notice
The Andersons reserves the right to refuse delivery of commodities containing transgenic genes and traits that are not commercially merchantable.
The Andersons fully supports the NGFA’s position that the promotion and sale of varieties that are not approved for export to key markets can cause economic harm to grain handlers and ultimately grain producers and with that, The Andersons Inc. has the right to reject delivery of commodities containing transgenic genes/traits that are not approved for sale in Japan, Mexico, the European Union, China or other US export markets.

About This Facility
Safety is a priority for The Andersons and our facility at Clymers, we encourage you to be aware of posted procedures within the plant.
You can access the plant off of CR 300 S through the main entrance. If you are delivering grain please turn your CB Radio to Channel 1 and if you are picking up DDGS you will be using Channel 3.
Dried Distillers Grain w/Solubles (DDGS) are being sold at the plant.
Please contact Lynn Fruchey, DDGS Merchant at 517-438-4991 for more information.
